title: Lunchline partnerships
description: A portfolio table: a tiny tracked eyebrow, then a grid of hairline-bordered cells (one column on phones, two on wide screens, an odd last cell left on its own), each with a logo, a large light company name and a short description, and an optional handwritten badge in a loose ellipse beside the logo. Linked cells tint white on hover and show a small 'visit' tag; the section's top hairline draws itself out.
notes: logos sit left-aligned and contained in a 10:3 slot (240×72 on phones, 333×100 on wide screens)
the badge uses the theme's --typeface-hand when it has one (lunchline-theme: Reenie Beanie)
the hover tag sits in the cell's corner; the original's follows the cursor
